Name: Hybrid: API registration + UI checkout address validation
Description:
End-to-end hybrid test covering the full user journey across API and UI layers.

Pre-condition (API): registers a unique user via POST /api/createAccount using Faker-generated data.

UI steps:
1. /login — authenticates with the API-created credentials.
2. /products — adds 2 randomly selected products to the cart.
3. /view_cart — verifies both items are present with correct attributes (name, price, quantity=1, total) and proceeds to checkout.
4. /checkout — parses the Delivery Address block and asserts every field (name, company, address, city, state, zip, country, phone) matches the registration payload.

Post-condition (API): deletes the user via DELETE /api/deleteAccount regardless of test outcome.

Name: API: create account → verify 201 → delete → verify 200
Description:
Smoke test for the account lifecycle via REST API.
Creates a user with Faker-generated data via POST /api/createAccount, asserts responseCode 201, then deletes the same user via DELETE /api/deleteAccount and asserts responseCode 200.
